summary: Iteration 6 verified end-to-end. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from 77→95 tests (all PASS in 11.66s under pytest-xdist -n2). Fixed 2 stale tests (form-template endpoint renamed to plural + campagne/dati-form schema changed comune_id→pratica_ids) and added 5 new test classes for iter-6: TestDeletePratica (3), TestSpaziZone (3), TestComuneReportSpazi (4), TestAdminComuniKPI (4), TestOnboardComuneLogo (2), TestFormTemplateSpazio (2). Frontend Playwright covered every checklist item: (6) Comune Profilo /comune/profilo shows tariffario-spazi with per-space canone input + Salva button; changing to 77.77 persists after reload with toast 'Canone aggiornato: Poster 6x3 Via Tiburtina'. (7) Comune Report /comune/report shows report-per-spazio table (8 rows for Roma), clicking a row expands storico. (8) CampagnaPlanner step Moduli now shows ONE modulo-pratica-{id} block PER SPACE (verified 2 blocks for 2 spazi: Roma Poster 6x3 Via Tiburtina + Milano Poster 6x3 Viale Certosa) each with own dynamic form + upload input; validation blocks Avanti with per-space error message; checkout + invio work end-to-end. (10) Public /spazi map markers show Leaflet Tooltip with space image (150x84px), name and price (verified via SVG mouseover event → tooltip html contains img+span). (11) filter-zona populates with 7 Roma zones ('Centro Storico', 'EUR', 'Esquilino', 'Prati', 'San Giovanni', 'Tiburtino', 'Trastevere'), selecting a zone filters cards (8→1 for Centro Storico), cards show zona in address ('· Centro Storico'); resetting comune resets zona to empty. (12) User dashboard filter pills filtro-tutte/filtro-BOZZA work; BOZZA rows show delete-pratica-{id} button, clicking with window.confirm dialog handler deletes and removes row from list (14→13 after delete). (13/14) Comune backoffice sidebar shows 'Comune di Roma' block (comune-logo-sidebar); superadmin onboard form has onboard-logo-input file input. (15) /admin dashboard shows kpi-per-comune table with 19 rows (kpi-comune-row-{id}); clicking Roma opens dettaglio-comune panel with 'PRATICHE 13, APPROVATE 2, INCASSO 4631.00€, FEE PIATTAFORMA 231.55€' + monthly chart + ultime pratiche list. /admin/comuni onboarding table has columns 'comune, regione, spazi, pratiche, approvate, incasso, fee 5%, stato'.

issues: React console warning 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' in Report component when rendering per-space rows — non-blocking; likely storico rows lacking key={idx} or key={row.data+importo}.

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED BY TESTER (1-line): frontend/src/pages/user/CampagnaPlanner.jsx:268 was calling undefined `comuneNome(p.comune_id)` — caused a hard React runtime error 'comuneNome is not defined' that broke the entire step-3 Moduli screen for every user. Replaced with inline lookup on comuniList state. This bug would have made iteration 6 requirement (8) completely non-functional.
server.py 946 lines — well over 700-line threshold (up from 813 in it5). Should split into routers/{auth,spazi,pratiche,campagne,comune,admin}.py before further growth.

GET /api/comune/report/spazi returns spazi even for L1 operator — no privacy concern here since the operator IS from that comune, but confirm this is intended (currently only require_role('comune') without livello gating).
Report.jsx has React 'unique key prop' warning in per-space storico rendering; low priority visual-only.

DELETE /pratiche/{id} also deletes log_stato entries — good, but does NOT clean up campagna.pratica_ids list if the pratica belonged to a campagna. Users deleting a bozza inside a campaign may leave dangling references. Consider $pull from campagne.pratica_ids too.
PATCH /comune/spazi/{id}/canone accepts arbitrary dict body without Pydantic model — works but bypasses validation. Consider CanoneIn(BaseModel){canone_giornaliero: float}.

rca of the issue: CampagnaPlanner.jsx step 3 crash: line 268 referenced `comuneNome(p.comune_id)` but the function was never defined in scope — only `comuniList` state exists. RCA: developer likely refactored from a helper function that was later removed but forgot to update the JSX usage. Reproduction: login user@demo.it → /campagne/nuova → complete step 1 (name+date) → step 2 (select spazi) → click Avanti → hard React error overlay 'ReferenceError: comuneNome is not defined'. Mitigation applied by tester: replaced with inline `(comuniList.find((c) => c.id === p.comune_id)?.nome) || "—"` — 1-line fix. After fix, full planner E2E passes with 2 modulo-pratica blocks visible + 'Campagna creata: 2 pratiche generate' toast on invio.
